description: Transformer architecture decomposed. Encoder-decoder (T5, BART) vs decoder-only (GPT, LLaMA). Block structure: attention + MLP + residual + layer norm. Modern variants: pre-norm vs post-norm, RMSNorm, SwiGLU, GQA (grouped-query attention), MoE (mixture of experts). The architecture that dominated NLP since 2017.

sub_mechanisms.name: transformer_block
sub_mechanisms.definition: Sub-layer 1: attention + residual + norm. Sub-layer 2: MLP + residual + norm. Stack N blocks.
sub_mechanisms.why: Compositional. Each block refines representations. Residual makes deep stacking trainable. Pre-norm variant (norm before sublayer) is more stable for very deep models.

sub_mechanisms.name: encoder_only_BERT
sub_mechanisms.definition: Stack of bidirectional attention layers. Trained with masked language modeling.
sub_mechanisms.why: Each position attends to all positions (no causal mask). Used for understanding tasks (classification, NER). BERT, RoBERTa, DeBERTa. Largely supplanted by encoder-decoder + decoder-only for generative tasks.

sub_mechanisms.name: decoder_only_GPT
sub_mechanisms.definition: Causal attention: position i attends only to positions ≤ i. Trained on next-token prediction.
sub_mechanisms.why: GPT, LLaMA, Mistral, Claude all decoder-only. Simpler than encoder-decoder. Foundation of modern LLMs. The architectural pattern of the 2020s.

sub_mechanisms.name: encoder_decoder
sub_mechanisms.definition: Encoder produces context; decoder generates conditioned on it. Original Transformer (Vaswani 2017), T5, BART.
sub_mechanisms.why: Natural for sequence-to-sequence (translation, summarisation). Cross-attention from decoder to encoder representations. Decoder-only with prompting now dominant; encoder-decoder hangs on for specific applications.

sub_mechanisms.name: causal_attention_mask
sub_mechanisms.definition: Triangular mask preventing future positions from contributing. Used in decoder-only models.
sub_mechanisms.why: Autoregressive training: each position predicts next. Mask enforces 'no peeking at future'. KV cache exploits the mask: only new token needs new K, V; past stays fixed.

sub_mechanisms.name: pre_norm_vs_post_norm
sub_mechanisms.definition: Pre-norm: norm before sublayer (residual passes through). Post-norm: norm after sublayer + residual (original).
sub_mechanisms.why: Pre-norm is more stable for deep networks (gradients flow through residual without norm). Most modern LLMs (LLaMA, Mistral) use pre-norm. Original post-norm needed warmup to train.

sub_mechanisms.name: RMSNorm
sub_mechanisms.definition: Root Mean Square Norm: normalize by RMS (no mean subtraction). Simpler than LayerNorm.
sub_mechanisms.why: ~7% faster than LayerNorm + comparable quality. LLaMA family uses RMSNorm. The micro-optimization that propagated through the LLM ecosystem.

sub_mechanisms.name: SwiGLU_activation
sub_mechanisms.definition: Swish-Gated Linear Unit. MLP: silu(W1·x) ⊙ (W2·x) → W3·result. Replaces ReLU/GeLU in modern LLMs.
sub_mechanisms.why: Empirically better quality than GeLU. Slightly more compute (3 matrices instead of 2). Used in LLaMA, PaLM, Mistral. The MLP nonlinearity standard since ~2022.

sub_mechanisms.name: rotary_position_embedding
sub_mechanisms.definition: RoPE: rotate Q, K by position-dependent angle. Encodes position via rotation in pair-dimensions.
sub_mechanisms.why: Extrapolates beyond training length. Used in LLaMA, PaLM, ChatGLM. Replaces absolute + sinusoidal embeddings. The position encoding choice for modern LLMs.

sub_mechanisms.name: grouped_query_attention
sub_mechanisms.definition: GQA: multiple query heads share K, V heads. K, V are smaller; attention math unchanged.
sub_mechanisms.why: Multi-Query Attention (MQA) shares K, V across all query heads — fast but quality loss. GQA is the compromise: ~4 K, V heads for ~32 query heads. Used in LLaMA-2, Mistral. KV cache is correspondingly smaller.

sub_mechanisms.name: mixture_of_experts
sub_mechanisms.definition: MoE: replace dense MLP with K experts; gating selects top-k experts per token.
sub_mechanisms.why: Sparse activation: model has many parameters but uses few per token. Mixtral 8x7B, GPT-4 (rumored), DeepSeek-MoE. Trade-off: training complexity, communication, load balancing.

sub_mechanisms.name: sliding_window_attention
sub_mechanisms.definition: Attend only within window of size W. Mistral uses 4096 window with longer context via chained windows.
sub_mechanisms.why: Linear instead of quadratic compute. Cost: information must flow through window chain to span long context. Hybrid approaches: some heads sliding, some full.

derivation_rules.name: residual_enables_deep_stacking
then: gradients flow through identity path to early layers
derivation_rules.why: Without residual: deep stack has vanishing gradients. With residual: gradient has identity shortcut to every layer. ResNet's insight, standard in Transformer. Why 100-layer transformers train.

derivation_rules.name: pre_norm_stabilises_deep_transformers
then: pre-norm avoids the training instability that post-norm has
derivation_rules.why: Post-norm: residual passes through norm → gradient depends on norm. Pre-norm: residual passes around norm → cleaner gradient flow. Modern LLMs use pre-norm.

derivation_rules.name: decoder_only_for_generation
derivation_rules.why: Simpler. Pretraining on next-token prediction at scale gives strong generative capability. Encoder-decoder needs careful task formulation. Architectural simplicity won.

derivation_rules.name: GQA_reduces_KV_cache_size
if: model uses grouped-query attention with G groups instead of full multi-head
then: KV cache size is reduced by G/H (H = total heads)
derivation_rules.why: KV cache stores K, V per head per layer per position. GQA: only G K, V heads (4-8 vs 32). KV cache 4-8x smaller. Critical for long-context serving memory.

derivation_rules.name: MoE_scales_parameters_without_scaling_compute
then: total parameters grow without proportional compute increase
derivation_rules.why: Mixtral 8x7B: 47B total params, ~13B active per token. Memory is high but compute is constant. The scaling trick when compute is the binding constraint.
